description: Use this only after the user approves the exact preview from cleanapp_prepare_report, including any source context and publication/notice permissions, and sending it to CleanApp. Permissions are frozen; do not upgrade them. Starts in private quarantine and returns a receipt. Report the recorded outcome precisely: held means received but blocked, not successful publication or notice delivery. Analysis not_required means AI analysis did not run for that cycle; explain the reason and next step. Older drafts retain their exact payload and permissions. A receipt is not a public report, sent notice or resolution. Reuse the same draft_token on retry. After timeout, check its tracking_token before retrying.

confirmed.description: True only after the user approves the exact report preview, its disclosed publication and notice permissions, and sending it to CleanApp.
